PHOENIX Pharmahandel
is a major European healthcare logistics and pharmaceutical wholesale company. While it distributes medical and pharmaceutical products,
it does not directly manufacture consumer smartwatches or standalone remote patient monitoring device brands
, though it supplies pharmacies with health tech and diagnostics.
Wearable Health Tech Overview
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Medical-grade wearable sensors (such as Abbott FreeStyle Libre or Dexcom) track interstitial glucose levels in real-time. Consumer smartwatches claiming non-invasive blood sugar tracking lack full medical clearance.

Smartwatches & Wearable ECG:
Advanced smartwatches capture single-lead ECG data to spot irregular heart rhythms like atrial fibrillation, alongside optical heart rate and blood oxygen monitoring.
